name: Redeeming Time
overview: Scripture calls believers to wisely number their days and apply their hearts to wisdom, recognizing the brevity and value of time (Psalms 90:12). In light of Christ’s redemption from the curse of the law (Galatians 3:13), Christians are urged to live as followers of God (Ephesians 5:1), transforming their minds to discern and fulfill God’s perfect will (Romans 12:2). The urgency of redeeming time is emphasized by the nearness of salvation, prompting believers to awaken from spiritual slumber and live purposefully (Romans 13:11).
